name: Tag Editor
overview: Edit tags directly on Jellyfin Web item detail pages.
description: Adds an administrator-only tag editor to movie, series, episode, and music album detail pages in Jellyfin Web. Loads automatically without editing web files or installing a JavaScript injector. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.x and its bundled web client.

versions.changelog: Installable server plugin with automatic web integration, tag-only updates, and stale-edit protection.
